maps.name: Drop-Off
maps.description: An industrial rooftop arena with control rooms, elevated platforms and working ziplines.
maps.notes: Adds 366 source placements: conduits, clamps, tanks, crates, furniture and structural details. Uses 97.06% of native world index capacity with no added dynamic entities. Preserves minimap, Northstar banners, displays, paint, lighting, safety volumes and ziplines. Some scenery and animated materials remain incomplete. Intro and evac are disabled. The UI atlas hotfix shares loading artwork and minimaps through ApexMaps.UI; geometry and lighting are unchanged.

maps.name: Phase Runner
maps.description: Snow, rock and industrial tunnels connect opposing bases beneath the phase machinery.
maps.notes: Adds 432 source scenery placements: supported ground plants, flowers, small snow rocks and power equipment. Uses 97.04% of native world index capacity with no added dynamic entities. Preserves minimap, displays, paint, lighting, team modes and catwalks. AI navigation and some layered/animated materials remain incomplete. The UI atlas hotfix shares loading artwork and minimaps through ApexMaps.UI; geometry and lighting are unchanged.

maps.name: Overflow
maps.description: An industrial arena with elevated lanes, molten channels and opposing bases.
maps.notes: 0.3.1 fixes the combined-install UI atlas crash using the shared ApexMaps.UI companion. Adds five new matched viewpoints. 0.3.0 adds distance haze, restored source colours and native glowing lights while preserving the existing lava appearance and gameplay. Some animated effects and decorations remain incomplete. Restart between previews; the earlier repeated-mode-change crash is unresolved. Vertex palette conversion remains incomplete.

maps.name: Party Crasher
maps.description: City streets, multilevel buildings and the crashed Voyage form a compact pilot arena.
maps.notes: 0.3.1 fixes the combined-install UI atlas crash using the shared ApexMaps.UI companion. Adds five new matched viewpoints. 0.3.0 adds 14 source signs/screens and 283 small light fixtures, native glow, restored texture colours and distance haze. Existing lighting and gameplay remain. Animated billboards, some transparent effects and distant scenery are incomplete. Restart between previews; the earlier repeated-mode-change crash is unresolved. Vertex palette conversion remains incomplete.

maps.name: Firing Range
maps.description: The original training landscape adapted as a Titanfall pilot sandbox.
maps.notes: 0.3.1 fixes the combined-install UI atlas crash using the shared ApexMaps.UI companion. Adds five new matched viewpoints. 0.3.0 adds campaign-style moving water with a softer grey-blue colour, distance haze and restored source colours. Preserves the 20 supply bins and seven zipline routes. Exact Apex water reflections, distant scenery and training interactions remain incomplete. Restart between previews; the earlier repeated-mode-change crash is unresolved. Vertex palette conversion remains incomplete.
